skill_name: Summarize the steps for creating a WordPress site
workflow: Creating a WordPress website requires setting up web hosting, installing WordPress, selecting a theme, adding plugins, and customizing the site to meet your needs. First, sign up for a web hosting plan, and then use the WordPress installation provided by the web hosting service. Once installed, select a theme and configure settings such as color, font, and logo. Then, start adding plugins to add advanced features to your website like contact forms, e-commerce tools, or a membership system. Final
